notes: Stored edit; transitivity of located_in. q1's 'no' before the edit needs Florence to lie outside southern Italy: the record's q1 bridge 'Florence is in central Italy' (firm) with a firm 'one part of Italy per place' rule (stated in q1's determinacy_why). The Birth of Venus is stored by city name (w1) or through the Uffizi (housed_in, with the catalogued chain housed_in o located_in ⊑ located_in). 'A place lies in one city' is firm (q2 asks 'which city'; w1's side fact: a painting is in one city at a time), so in w1 the painting's place in the Uffizi gives way, the side fact the record's w1 lists. q3 compares two works' cities (fol).

fol.notes: located_in is a relation (transitive in RELATIONS.md; only one step is needed here), housed_in a function (functional). The catalogued chain housed_in o located_in is the firm museum_chain rule, and 'a place lies in one city' is firm, as in the DL file. 'The same city' asks for a city both works are located in. The Uffizi, the works and the cities are an enumeration (unique names). w1 stores The Birth of Venus under Florence by name, so with the Uffizi in Naples its place in the Uffizi gives way (the side fact w1's assumes list, as in the DL file); w2 stores it only through the Uffizi, so it moves to Naples.

venus_uffizi.says: Botticelli's The Birth of Venus hangs in the Uffizi Gallery. (stored)

museum_chain.says: A work is located where the museum that holds it is located.
museum_chain.z3: ForAll([x, m, c], Implies(And(housed_in(x) == m, located_in(m, c)), located_in(x, c)))

one_city.says: A place lies in one city.
one_city.z3: ForAll([x, c, d], Implies(And(city(c), city(d), located_in(x, c), located_in(x, d)), c == d))

queries.ask: Exists(c, And(city(c), located_in(venus, c), located_in(david, c)))

label_corrections.why: 'In the same city' is a join over named individuals: venus : located_in some (City and inv(located_in) value david); the 'no' follows from the firm one-city rule the DL file already has. No arithmetic.
